name: 33037 · Key Largo, FL
findings: ZIP 33037 (Key Largo) has 112 nonprofit organizations. 39 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 35 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33037 (Key Largo) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 33037 (Key Largo) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.3 times the typical level).
